usageNotes: Returns the top-level access directory index for Proxmox Datacenter Manager, listing available sub-resources under /access (such as /access/users, /access/roles, /access/tickets). Useful as a discovery call to confirm which access-management endpoints are available on the connected PDM instance. Requires no special privileges — any authenticated user or API token can call it.
tips: Returns null per the spec; the actual value is the HTTP response body listing child endpoints — parse the 'data' array from the JSON envelope.
Use this as a lightweight connectivity/auth check: a 200 response confirms the API token and host are reachable.
